alsoTry.name: The Anchovy Bar
alsoTry.note: The same chefs' seafood bar nearby on O'Farrell Street.

bookingOpens: Online on OpenTable. Dining-room tables open 30 days ahead; the private and semi-private rooms can be booked 90 days ahead.
groups: Online bookings are for one to six guests. The Balcony seats up to 10 and the Mezzanine up to 18, both with a $130 family-style menu and a food and drink minimum; the Workshop room takes up to 40 seated or 50 standing, and the whole restaurant can be booked. Cancelling a group booking within five days costs half the minimum, on the day the full minimum.
